instruction:
You are a road corridor drainage and ITS resilience engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-01 low-point package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. FHWA HEC-22, MUTCD, EPA SWMM, Civil 3D, OpenRoads, and InfoDrainage-style routes shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Road segment: `RD-SSC01-001`
- Low point: `LP-01`
- Drainage catchment: `DRN-CAT-01`
- Upstream bypass record: `DRN-BYP-01`
- Low-point inlet: `DRN-PIT-01`
- Storm-drain reach: `DRN-PIPE-01`
- HGL calculation record: `HGL-01`
- Field cabinet: `CAB-01`
- Variable message sign: `VMS-01`
- Network operating case: `ITS-NET-01`
- Battery schedule: `BATT-01`
- Criteria memo: `CRIT-SSC01-001`
- Selected VMS message: `WATER OVER ROAD - USE LEFT`

## Drainage And Spread

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Runoff coefficient `C` | {{ runoff_coefficient }} |
| Rainfall intensity `I` | {{ rainfall_intensity_mm_h }} mm/h |
| Catchment area `A` | {{ catchment_area_ha }} ha |
| Upstream bypass flow | {{ upstream_bypass_flow_m3_s }} m3/s |
| Cross slope | {{ cross_slope_pct }} % |
| Longitudinal slope | {{ longitudinal_slope_pct }} % |
| Gutter Manning source field | {{ gutter_mannings_n_thousandths }} / 1000 = 0.016 |
| Allowable spread | {{ allowable_spread_m }} m |

Drainage calculations:

- Peak runoff is `Q = C x I x A / 360` in m3/s.
- Gutter approach flow is peak runoff plus upstream bypass flow.
- Use gutter Manning `n = 0.016` exactly.
- Use the triangular-gutter relation `Q = 0.376/n x Sx^(5/3) x SL^(1/2) x T^(8/3)`.
- Solve for spread: `T = (Q x n / (0.376 x Sx^(5/3) x SL^(1/2)))^(3/8)`.
- Convert slopes from percent to m/m before using the formula.
- Curb depth is `T x Sx`.
- Spread margin is allowable spread minus computed spread.

## Inlet, HGL, And Cabinet

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Inlet efficiency | {{ inlet_efficiency }} |
| Inlet capture capacity | {{ inlet_capture_capacity_m3_s }} m3/s |
| Pipe diameter | {{ pipe_diameter_mm }} mm |
| Pipe length | {{ pipe_length_m }} m |
| Pipe Manning source field | {{ pipe_mannings_n_thousandths }} / 1000 = 0.013 |
| Pit loss coefficient | {{ pit_loss_coefficient }} |
| Tailwater level | {{ tailwater_level_m }} m |
| LP-01 pavement level | {{ road_low_point_level_m }} m |
| CAB-01 pad level | {{ cabinet_pad_level_m }} m |
| Minimum HGL clearance | {{ minimum_hgl_clearance_mm }} mm |
| Minimum cabinet freeboard | {{ minimum_cabinet_freeboard_m }} m |

Inlet and HGL calculations:

- Inlet intercepted flow is the lesser of `gutter approach flow x inlet efficiency` and inlet capture capacity.
- Residual ponding flow is approach flow minus intercepted flow, not less than zero.
- Pipe area is `pi x D^2 / 4`, with diameter converted to metres.
- Full-pipe hydraulic radius is `D / 4`.
- Velocity is intercepted flow divided by pipe area.
- Use pipe Manning `n = 0.013` exactly.
- Friction slope is `(V x n / R^(2/3))^2`.
- Friction loss is friction slope times pipe length.
- Pit loss is `K x V^2 / (2g)`.
- Upstream HGL is tailwater level plus friction loss plus pit loss.
- HGL clearance is LP-01 pavement level minus upstream HGL, converted to mm.
- Pavement water level is LP-01 pavement level plus curb depth.
- Controlling water level is the greater of pavement water level and upstream HGL.
- Cabinet freeboard is CAB-01 pad level minus controlling water level.
- Cabinet flood depth is the amount by which controlling water level exceeds CAB-01 pad level, not less than zero.

## VMS, Network, And Battery

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| VMS character height | {{ vms_character_height_in }} in |
| Road design speed | {{ road_design_speed_kmh }} km/h |
| Reading rate | {{ reading_rate_chars_s }} chars/s |
| Selected message length | {{ vms_message_length_chars }} chars |
| CCTV cameras | {{ camera_count }} |
| CCTV data rate per camera | {{ camera_data_rate_mbps }} Mbps |
| VMS data rate | {{ vms_data_rate_mbps }} Mbps |
| Controller data rate | {{ controller_data_rate_mbps }} Mbps |
| Water-level sensor data rate | {{ sensor_data_rate_mbps }} Mbps |
| Network overhead | {{ network_overhead_pct }} % |
| Future capacity buffer | {{ future_capacity_buffer_pct }} % |
| Uplink capacity | {{ uplink_capacity_mbps }} Mbps |
| Battery capacity | {{ battery_capacity_kwh }} kWh |
| Battery efficiency | {{ battery_efficiency }} |
| Critical cabinet load | {{ critical_load_w }} W |
| Required autonomy | {{ required_autonomy_h }} h |

VMS, network, and battery calculations:

- VMS legibility distance is character height times 40 ft/in, converted to metres.
- Reading time is legibility distance divided by design speed, with speed converted to m/s.
- Message margin is `reading time x reading rate - selected message length`.
- Base network load is `camera count x camera data rate + VMS data rate + controller data rate + sensor data rate`.
- Required network load is base load times overhead factor times future-buffer factor.
- Network headroom is uplink capacity minus required network load.
- Battery runtime is `battery capacity x battery efficiency / (critical load / 1000)`.
- Battery margin is battery runtime minus required autonomy.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when spread margin, HGL clearance, cabinet freeboard, VMS message margin, network headroom, and battery margin all pass the criteria above.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Explain the calculations briefly, preserve the object IDs above, and state that the baseline source pack passes the current synthetic checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable source-pack hardening, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "peak_runoff_m3_s": <numeric_value>,
  "gutter_approach_flow_m3_s": <numeric_value>,
  "spread_width_m": <numeric_value>,
  "spread_margin_m": <numeric_value>,
  "curb_depth_m": <numeric_value>,
  "inlet_intercepted_flow_m3_s": <numeric_value>,
  "residual_ponding_flow_m3_s": <numeric_value>,
  "hgl_upstream_m": <numeric_value>,
  "hgl_clearance_mm": <numeric_value>,
  "cabinet_freeboard_m": <numeric_value>,
  "cabinet_flood_depth_m": <numeric_value>,
  "vms_reading_time_s": <numeric_value>,
  "vms_message_margin_chars": <numeric_value>,
  "network_headroom_mbps": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_runtime_h": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_margin_h": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

[meta]
name = "road-low-point-resilience-package"
description = "SSC-01 road low-point drainage and field-equipment resilience metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound road low-point resilience metrics from a deterministic SSC-01 task-owned source pack. The template combines rational-method runoff, HEC-22-style gutter spread, one storm-drain HGL reach, field-cabinet flood freeboard, VMS reading time, network headroom, and battery runtime for one corridor low-point case."
discipline = "civil"
category = "road-resilience"
standards = ["FHWA HEC-22", "FHWA MUTCD", "EPA SWMM"]
tags = ["civil", "road", "drainage", "hgl", "its", "vms", "battery", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.runoff_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "DRN-CAT-01 runoff coefficient for the contributing low-point catchment"
min = 0.82
max = 0.82

[params.rainfall_intensity_mm_h]
type = "float"
unit = "mm/h"
description = "STORM-01 rainfall intensity for the low-point design burst"
min = 95.0
max = 95.0

[params.catchment_area_ha]
type = "float"
unit = "ha"
description = "DRN-CAT-01 contributing catchment area draining to LP-01"
min = 1.35
max = 1.35

[params.upstream_bypass_flow_m3_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/s"
description = "DRN-BYP-01 upstream inlet bypass flow reaching LP-01"
min = 0.06
max = 0.06

[params.cross_slope_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "RD-SSC01-001 pavement crossfall at LP-01"
min = 2.5
max = 2.5

[params.longitudinal_slope_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "RD-SSC01-001 approach longitudinal slope into LP-01"
min = 0.8
max = 0.8

[params.gutter_mannings_n_thousandths]
type = "float"
description = "DRN-GUT-01 Manning roughness for the pavement gutter, expressed as n x 1000 to avoid prompt display rounding"
min = 16.0
max = 16.0

[params.allowable_spread_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "CRIT-SSC01-001 allowable spread before blocking the protected travel lane"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.inlet_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "DRN-PIT-01 low-point inlet interception efficiency"
min = 0.82
max = 0.82

[params.inlet_capture_capacity_m3_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/s"
description = "DRN-PIT-01 maximum inlet capture capacity"
min = 0.31
max = 0.31

[params.pipe_diameter_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "DRN-PIPE-01 storm-drain diameter leaving DRN-PIT-01"
min = 600.0
max = 600.0

[params.pipe_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "DRN-PIPE-01 reach length to the downstream tailwater node"

max = 48.0

[params.pipe_mannings_n_thousandths]
type = "float"
description = "DRN-PIPE-01 full-pipe Manning roughness, expressed as n x 1000 to avoid prompt display rounding"

max = 13.0

[params.pit_loss_coefficient]

description = "HGL-01 pit and junction loss coefficient at DRN-PIT-01"

max = 0.7

type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "HGL-01 downstream tailwater level"
min = 41.55
max = 41.55

type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "RD-SSC01-001 pavement level at LP-01"
min = 42.20
max = 42.20

[params.cabinet_pad_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "CAB-01 cabinet pad level adjacent to LP-01"
min = 42.58
max = 42.58

[params.minimum_cabinet_freeboard_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "CRIT-SSC01-001 minimum cabinet freeboard above controlling water level"
min = 0.15
max = 0.15

[params.vms_character_height_in]
type = "float"
unit = "in"
description = "VMS-01 character height for the selected low-point warning message"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.road_design_speed_kmh]
type = "float"
unit = "km/h"
description = "RD-SSC01-001 design operating speed for the VMS reading check"

unit = "chars/s"

min = 0.6

type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"

min = 0.2
max = 0.2

type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "ITS-NET-01 protocol and operating overhead"
min = 20.0
max = 20.0

[params.future_capacity_buffer_pct]
type = "float"
unit = "%"
description = "ITS-NET-01 future capacity buffer"
min = 25.0
max = 25.0

[params.uplink_capacity_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "ITS-NET-01 available cabinet uplink capacity"
min = 50.0
max = 50.0

[params.battery_capacity_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "BATT-01 installed usable nominal battery capacity"
min = 5.2
max = 5.2

[params.battery_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "BATT-01 effective battery and inverter efficiency"
min = 0.88
max = 0.88

unit = "W"
description = "CAB-01 selected critical load for low-point warning, CCTV, controller, and telemetry"
min = 450.0
max = 450.0

[params.required_autonomy_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "CRIT-SSC01-001 required outage autonomy during the storm case"
min = 6.0
max = 6.0

[params.minimum_hgl_clearance_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "CRIT-SSC01-001 minimum HGL clearance below the LP-01 pavement level"
min = 150.0
max = 150.0

[outputs.peak_runoff_m3_s]
description = "Rational-method peak runoff from DRN-CAT-01"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.gutter_approach_flow_m3_s]
description = "Peak runoff plus upstream bypass flow reaching LP-01"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.spread_width_m]
description = "HEC-22-style triangular gutter spread at LP-01"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.spread_margin_m]
description = "Allowable spread minus computed spread"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.curb_depth_m]
description = "Pavement gutter depth at the curb"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.inlet_intercepted_flow_m3_s]
description = "Flow intercepted by DRN-PIT-01 after efficiency and capacity limits"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.residual_ponding_flow_m3_s]
description = "Approach flow not intercepted by DRN-PIT-01"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.hgl_upstream_m]
description = "Hydraulic grade line at DRN-PIT-01"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.hgl_clearance_mm]
description = "LP-01 pavement level minus upstream HGL"
tolerance = 0.5

[outputs.cabinet_freeboard_m]
description = "CAB-01 pad level minus controlling water level"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.cabinet_flood_depth_m]
description = "Depth of controlling water above CAB-01 pad"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.vms_reading_time_s]
description = "Available reading time for VMS-01 at the road design speed"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.vms_message_margin_chars]
description = "Readable character capacity minus selected VMS message length"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.network_headroom_mbps]
description = "Cabinet uplink capacity minus required low-point operating bandwidth"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.battery_runtime_h]
description = "BATT-01 runtime for the selected critical cabinet load"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.battery_margin_h]
description = "Battery runtime minus required outage autonomy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when spread, HGL, cabinet, VMS, network, and battery margins pass"
tolerance = 0.01
